scope: System-prompt variants for lapis next-prompt (Tab) guesses, measured against a fixed set of past prompts through the private Infinity DeepSeek endpoint. Prompt behavior only; no GUI, attention-protocol, long-run or 32-session load qualification.

source.head: 335cc4a
source.dirty_note: lean prompt, its test and docs; the provider chain commit is the base

tools.predictor: Infatoshi/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-MXFP4-heretic served by vLLM, temperature 0, max 4096 tokens
tools.set: 41 prompts sampled from local interactive Claude Code and Codex transcripts since 2026-09-15 (seed 23); fixed after sampling

method.prompt_variants: The same bundle, provider chain and parser for every variant; only next_prompt.SYSTEM changed. Each item produced up to three candidates, graded in batches of eight by the judge. Top-1 sendable means the first candidate scored 2; top-3 sendable means any candidate scored 2.
method.mode: Question top-1 counts items the judge labelled question or status whose first candidate is itself a question (a question mark or a question word). Command top-1 counts first candidates that open with an imperative verb.
method.variants: baseline (the best-version checklist), mode (the checklist plus an explicit question/result/plan rule), predictive (actual-message framing plus the mode rule, checklist kept), analysis (one analysis field before the candidates), predictive_analysis (both), lean (actual-message framing and mode rule, checklist removed), examples (predictive plus five generic examples).

examples.note: nine items ungraded when the judge hit its weekly limit

findings.winner: lean: 5/41 sendable top guesses against 3/41 baseline, 11/41 intent against 7/41, 7 command top guesses against 13, and 1665 ms against 2368 ms. The improvement is within sampling noise on sendable count, but the command reduction and question-mode increase are the targeted mechanism.
findings.introspection: analysis alone left top-1 sendable at 3/41, raised top-3 sendable to 5/41 and question top-1 to 5/17, and cost 359 ms. predictive_analysis had the best top-3 coverage (6/41 sendable, 15/41 intent) but a lower top-1 (2/41). Introspection improves candidate coverage, not the first candidate.
findings.checklist: keeping the 11-item best-version checklist (mode, predictive) raised intent matches but did not raise sendable top guesses; removing it (lean) halved command top guesses. The checklist is the main source of the action bias.

limitations: 41 prompts is a screen, not a release gate; the top-1 difference is two prompts.

One judge model. A second judge through Infinity was attempted, but the reasoning model exhausted the 4096-token budget on eight-item batches and many batches returned no content, so those partial scores are not used.
The examples variant is scored on 32 of 41 items because the judge hit its weekly limit; its percentages are not directly comparable.
No GUI Tab interaction was exercised.
The raw prompts and predictions are kept out of the repository; only aggregate metrics and aggregate mode counts are recorded.
